reports.title: Frontier Airlines Delivers Record Third Quarter 2026 Revenue of $1.4 billion, up 53 percent Year-over-Year, and Adjusted EPS Significantly Above Guidance Overcoming High Fuel Prices

lines: Frontier Airlines Delivers Record Third Quarter 2026 Revenue of $1.4 billion, up 53 percent Year-over-Year, and Adjusted EPS Significantly Above Guidance Overcoming High Fuel Prices

Expected adjusted (non-GAAP) diluted earnings per share for the fourth quarter of 2026, as noted below, reflects continued expected progress across key commercial initiatives and strong travel demand, with forecast RASM for the fourth quarter of 2026 again expected to be up over 20 percent as compared to the corresponding 2025 quarter, while elevated fuel prices are an expected cost headwind.
Fourth quarter capacity is expected to increase 5 to 6 percent versus the corresponding 2025 quarter.
